maya (CSM): Kicking off Foxglove onboarding — looping folks in. Goal: 30-day pilot. High-level success = stable integration + acceptable perf for their search flows. Who owns which areas on Foxglove's side?
leo (Foxglove PM): Hi Maya — I'll be the PM. Technical lead is @esther but she's OOO until Mon. Okta for SSO. Data is ~50GB, will start with a representative subset. Weekly sync Tues 10am PT works.
sam (SE): Thanks — can you share a sample dataset + schema? I'll build the initial integration runbook. Need S3 creds or signed URL to pull samples. Also will validate tokenization + latency profiles.
irene (Onboard): I'll drive the internal checklist: SSO (SAML) setup, sample ingest, API key provisioning, dashboard access, training session. Target milestones: basic integration by day 7, end-to-end demo by day 14, full pilot by day 30.
leo (Foxglove PM): I'll provision a temp S3 bucket and restricted creds — ETA tomorrow morning. Also cc'ing our compliance reviewer @marco — he may request SOC2 artifacts.
maya (CSM): Here’s our compliance one-pager: https://redwood.ai/compliance/one-pager — @marco if you need the SOC2 pack I can loop security for the deeper docs.
sam (SE): For ingestion: example curl to upload a file for validation: ```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <KEY>' -F 'file=@sample.ndjson' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/uploads
``` I’ll validate schema and ingest pipeline once we have sample.
leo (Foxglove PM): Noted — also flagging renewal risk early: if latency >1.5s under pilot traffic we likely won't convert. Wanted to surface that so it's visible.
maya (CSM): :thumbsup: we'll instrument telemetry in Redwood Console and create dashboards. Proposed success criteria to agree on: 1) demo by day 14, 2) median p50 <1s and p99 <1.5s for pilot calls, 3) automated ingest working with sample data, 4) initial end-user feedback >=80% positive from trial group.
irene (Onboard): I'll add those to the playbook and attach prompt templates + evaluation sets. Will share the doc by EOD.
sam (SE): One potential blocker — need to confirm max context length required by their app. @leo what’s the longest context you need?
leo (Foxglove PM): Usually 1024 tokens, occasionally 2048 for threaded conversations. We should plan for 2048 if possible.
maya (CSM): Great. I'll send the recurring invite for Tues 10am PT and create a shared task board. Also quick Q: who signs off on estimated monthly spend? @ana_fin?
leo (Foxglove PM): Correct — finance contact is @ana_fin, cc'ing her here. She'll need a usage estimate before approval.
deploy-bot: Meeting created: Foxglove onboarding — recurring Tuesdays 10:00 PT. Link: https://meet.redwood.ai/meet/foxglove
irene (Onboard): Quick follow-up: I'll schedule a day-3 joint run (Sam + Foxglove technical) to run initial ingest and surface schema issues. I'll post the runbook link in this thread when ready.
